title: Heinrich Weber, Lehrbuch der Algebra: German LaTeX and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Heinrich Weber Lehrbuch der Algebra record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record contains German source transcription, English translation working drafts, source scans, repair ledgers, and cumulative readers.

Latest public payload update. The current public payload includes Weber_Cumulative_ThreeVolumes_Batch137_FinalActiveGapClosure_Vol1_BulkAudit_20260613.zip, Weber_Cumulative_ThreeVolumes_Batch138_RecursiveHeuristicAudit_ControlFootnoteFix_20260613.zip, and Weber_B139_heuristic_fix.zip. Batch137 is a recursive active-ledger closure and Volume I bulk scan-review package, not a new linear continuation endpoint and not a critical edition. Batch138 is a focused Volume II section 6 control-character footnote fix. B139 is a focused off-ledger Volume II English section 49 repair splitting merged display tag 5--6 into source-aligned equations (5) and (6) and adding a recursive range-tag scan rule.

Status at a glance. Volume I is represented as a repaired/source-scan-audited working edition; Volume II has cumulative German/English reader material through section 176 plus localized recursive repairs; Volume III remains the current repaired cumulative from the earlier baseline. Batch137 supersedes the public Batch132 ledger status and reports the active 112-row ledger at 112/112 closed, while still carrying off-ledger next-work caveats. OCR, display ledgers, and core-intake patch CSVs are omission guards and locator layers, not independent authority.

Local post-public Phase 2 status, 2026-07-02. The local German workpass now records coherent re-transcriptions or verified faithful checks for sections 141, 148, 149, 151, 153-156, 158, 162, 163, 165, and 167-179, with sections 171-172 re-verified as genuine map-phase transcriptions. The current German workpass compiles to 403 pages. Section 173 repaired a severe Gaussian-integer reconstruction, including dropped footnotes, fabricated numbering, and a wrong Gaussian-prime list. Section 174 removed fabricated equation tags and restored the Eisenstein-integer source structure. Sections 175-176 removed fabricated tags and restored radical/metacyclic prose, footnotes, and section-boundary material. Section 177 restored the alternating-group simplicity proof prose while preserving verified cycle computations. Section 178 restored the Hilbert citation/footnote, corrected Weber's Π(n) factorial notation, and removed fabricated editorial/Eisenstein labels. Section 179 restored the real-radicals section order, the Hölder/Kneser footnote, missing displays, and the geometric-problems tail. Remaining held/open ranges include section 69, section 138 numbering/layout, p466, and section 180 onward. This local status is queued for a later deliberate compact Weber refresh; it is not a new public reader release, not English synchronization, not whole-Volume-I certification, and not a critical edition.

Quality note. These are working/source-witnessed drafts and repair packets, not certified critical editions. Some Weber continuation and audit ranges have known compression/omission risk, and Batch137's included Volume II patch candidates should not be treated as applied fixes unless later integrated. Readers should verify important formulas, theorem statements, tables, and notation against the included source witnesses and ledgers.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
